section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of 'Openness to experiences' using the Big Five Structure Inventory (Arendasy et al., 2011). The inventory is based on item response theory, shows good correlations with NEO-PI-R, and has high internal consistency. It comprises six facets (fantasy, aesthetics, feelings, actions, ideas, and norms/values) with 10 items each, totaling 60 items, and was administered without time restriction.
